title: ATEEZ: The Golden Hour Era
description: Ten questions on the first three parts of ATEEZ's Golden Hour series (2024 to 2025): Work, Ice on My Teeth, Lemon Drop, charts and festivals.

questions.question: Which song led Golden Hour: Part.1, the ATEEZ EP released on May 31, 2024?
questions.fun_fact: Part.1 was the group's tenth EP and opened the Golden Hour series. It debuted at No. 2 on the Billboard 200 and sold over 1.5 million copies in its first week.

questions.question: In the Work music video, ATEEZ take on odd jobs such as diner shifts and mining for what?
questions.fun_fact: The choreography for Work was co-created by member San, and the song came out the same day as its parent EP.

questions.question: Which American rapper joined ATEEZ on Work Pt.4, a remix released in August 2024?
questions.fun_fact: Work got three official remixes. The first, Work Pt.2, paired the group with Dutch DJ Don Diablo on June 5, 2024.

questions.question: Where did Golden Hour: Part.2 debut on the US Billboard 200 in November 2024?
questions.fun_fact: The EP earned 184,000 equivalent album units in its first week, giving ATEEZ a second No. 1 after The World EP.Fin: Will in 2023.

questions.question: Ice on My Teeth pairs an R&B foundation with which string instrument?
questions.fun_fact: Released on November 15, 2024, the song led the eleventh EP, Golden Hour: Part.2. Yunho described it as a song about knowing your worth.

questions.question: Which ATEEZ single became the group's first entry on the Billboard Hot 100, in June 2025?
questions.fun_fact: It entered at No. 69, making ATEEZ the third Korean boy band to reach the Hot 100. It led Golden Hour: Part.3, released June 13, 2025.

questions.question: Which title song led the In Your Fantasy Edition of Golden Hour: Part.3 in July 2025?
questions.fun_fact: The deluxe edition came out on July 11, 2025, and its title song entered the Billboard Hot 100 at No. 68, weeks after Lemon Drop.

questions.question: ATEEZ played which US festival in April 2024, a first for any K-pop boy group?
questions.fun_fact: They played the festival on April 12 and 19, 2024, and on April 20 they threw the first pitch at a Los Angeles Dodgers game.

questions.question: ATEEZ headlined the Mawazine festival on June 23, 2024. In which country is the festival held?
questions.fun_fact: Mawazine takes place in Rabat. ATEEZ were the first K-pop act to headline it, years after filming their debut video in the Moroccan Sahara.

questions.question: On the 2025 European leg of the Towards the Light: Will to Power tour, ATEEZ sold out which Paris venue?
questions.fun_fact: ATEEZ became the first K-pop group to headline a sold-out show at this arena, which is billed as the largest indoor venue in Europe.

title: Wonder Girls True or False
description: Ten true or false statements on Wonder Girls, from the 2007 JYP debut and Tell Me to the US tour, the Reboot band era and the 2017 farewell.

questions.question: Wonder Girls made their February 2007 debut with the single Tell Me.
questions.fun_fact: Their debut single was Irony, from the EP The Wonder Begins. Tell Me arrived later in 2007 as the lead single of The Wonder Years.

questions.question: Before their debut, the members were introduced to viewers in a TV show called MTV Wonder Girls.
questions.fun_fact: At their first showcase in the MTV studio, the group covered Don't Cha by the Pussycat Dolls alongside original songs such as Irony.

questions.question: Tell Me, the group's 2007 hit, samples the 1986 song Two of Hearts by Stacey Q.
questions.fun_fact: Written and produced by Park Jin-young, Tell Me spent six non-consecutive weeks at No. 1 on KBS's Music Bank.

questions.question: So Hot was first released in 2009, after the group had begun its US activities.
questions.fun_fact: So Hot came out on May 22, 2008, four months before Nobody, and it topped online charts soon after its release.

questions.question: On the 2009 Jonas Brothers World Tour, Wonder Girls opened only 13 of the North American shows.
questions.fun_fact: The group was first booked for 13 dates but ended up joining the Jonas Brothers for a total of 45 concerts.

questions.question: The 2010 single 2 Different Tears was recorded in Korean, English and Japanese.
questions.fun_fact: It was recorded in Korean, English and Chinese, and its video features cameos by Park Jin-young and comedian Bobby Lee.

questions.question: In 2012, the group starred in a TV movie, The Wonder Girls, broadcast on the US channel TeenNick.
questions.fun_fact: The film premiered on February 2, 2012 and featured Like Money, an English-language song that had not been released yet.

questions.question: In the band lineup of the 2015 album Reboot, Sunmi was the group's drummer.
questions.fun_fact: Sunmi played bass, Yubin drums, Hyerim guitar and Yeeun piano. I Feel You served as the album's lead single.

questions.question: Why So Lonely, released in July 2016, was the first Wonder Girls single not written by J.Y. Park.
questions.fun_fact: Hyerim, Sunmi and Yubin wrote it with Hong Ji-sang, and the reggae-pop track went to No. 1 on the Gaon Digital Chart.

questions.question: The group's final single, Draw Me, came out in February 2017 to celebrate ten years since their debut.
questions.fun_fact: Draw Me was released on February 10, 2017, about two weeks after JYP Entertainment announced the end of the group.

title: Red Velvet: From Happiness to Cosmic
description: Ten easy questions on Red Velvet's first ten years with SM, from the 2014 debut Happiness to Feel My Rhythm, Chill Kill and Cosmic.

questions.question: Which single did Red Velvet debut with in August 2014?
questions.fun_fact: Chad Hugo of The Neptunes co-produced the song, and the four-member group gave its debut stage on KBS's Music Bank.

questions.question: Which member joined Red Velvet in March 2015, turning the quartet into a five-piece?
questions.fun_fact: She was introduced just before the first EP, Ice Cream Cake, whose title track video was filmed in a desert near Palmdale, California.

questions.question: Which 2016 EP put the spotlight on Red Velvet's softer, R&B-leaning velvet concept, after the album The Red?
questions.fun_fact: Released on March 17, 2016 and led by One of These Nights, it answered The Red, which had shown the group's brighter red concept.

questions.question: Which Red Velvet song, first released in 2016, was later heard in the animated film Trolls World Tour?
questions.fun_fact: It led the group's third EP in September 2016, and its cartoon-style video shows the members playing tricks on each other.

questions.question: In April 2018, Red Velvet sang Bad Boy at the concert Spring Is Coming. In which city was it held?
questions.fun_fact: The show made Red Velvet the first SM Entertainment act in fifteen years, since Shinhwa, to perform in North Korea.

questions.question: Feel My Rhythm (2022) samples Air on the G String by which composer?
questions.fun_fact: The music video is staged like an opera and pays homage to famous artworks such as The Swing and Ophelia.

questions.question: Chill Kill, released in November 2023, was Red Velvet's first Korean studio album since which year?
questions.fun_fact: The previous one was Perfect Velvet in 2017. Chill Kill holds ten tracks, led by the title song of the same name.

questions.question: Which EP did Red Velvet release in June 2024, shortly before the group's 10th anniversary?
questions.fun_fact: A new version with the extra song Sweet Dreams came out on August 1, 2024, to mark the 10th anniversary.

questions.question: With which EP did the sub-unit Irene & Seulgi debut in July 2020?
questions.fun_fact: Their cover of S.E.S.'s Be Natural as SM Rookies helped inspire the unit, which returned with the EP Tilt in May 2025.

questions.question: What was the name of Red Velvet's first solo concert, held in August 2017?
questions.fun_fact: A third show was added because of demand, and the Red Room concerts were later taken to Japan in 2018.

title: K-pop Groups That Debuted in 2025
description: Hard questions on K-pop groups that debuted in 2025: the labels behind them, the shows that formed them and the releases they debuted with.

questions.question: Which agency launched Hearts2Hearts, who debuted on February 24, 2025 with The Chase?
questions.fun_fact: The group name contains S2, a nod to a heart emoticon, and the group was first revealed by a surprise trailer at an SM Town concert in January 2025.

questions.question: KiiiKiii debuted in March 2025 with the EP Uncut Gem. Which label formed the group?
questions.fun_fact: The name plays on kiki, a Korean sound for giggling, and on the English word key.

questions.question: Which song led KickFlip's debut EP, Flip It, Kick It!, released in January 2025?
questions.fun_fact: J.Y. Park first teased the group at the 2024 MAMA Awards in Los Angeles, and its name comes from a skateboarding trick.

questions.question: With which single did BigHit Music's CORTIS officially debut on August 18, 2025?
questions.fun_fact: The choreography for the debut single is danced on treadmills. CORTIS is BigHit Music's third group after BTS and Tomorrow X Together.

questions.question: Which label formed ALLDAY PROJECT, a co-ed group that debuted in June 2025 with the single album Famous?
questions.fun_fact: The name AllDay was reportedly coined by will.i.am of Black Eyed Peas when he first saw the five members together.

questions.question: Through which SBS survival show was AHOF formed before its July 2025 debut?
questions.fun_fact: AHOF stands for All-time Hall Of Famer, and it sounds like the Korean word for nine, a nod to the group's nine members.

questions.question: Which boy group came out of JTBC's Project 7 and debuted in April 2025 with the EP Eternalt?
questions.fun_fact: The group is managed by Uncore, a label set up by SLL and YG Plus, and won its first music show trophy six days after debut.

questions.question: IDID, formed through Starship's show Debut's Plan, debuted in September 2025 with which EP?
questions.fun_fact: IDID was Starship's first new boy group in five years, since Cravity, and the debut EP was led by the single Chan-Ran.

questions.question: Baby DONT Cry, a P Nation girl group, debuted on June 23, 2025 with which single album?
questions.fun_fact: Its title song of the same name pushes back against judging people only by their achievements and numbers.

questions.question: AtHeart, who debuted in August 2025 with the EP Plot Twist, were formed by which American agency?
questions.fun_fact: Titan Content was co-founded in November 2023 by Nikki Semin-Han, a former chief executive of SM Entertainment.

title: K-pop Winter and Christmas Songs
description: A festive, easy quiz: match ten K-pop winter and Christmas releases, from BoA's Merry-Chri to GOT7's Winter Heptagon, with the acts behind them.

questions.question: Which girl group released Merry & Happy, a Christmas reissue of its first studio album, in December 2017?
questions.fun_fact: The reissue of Twicetagram added two new songs: Heart Shaker and the title song Merry & Happy, written by J.Y. Park.

questions.question: Christmas EveL, a holiday single album from November 2021, comes from which boy band?
questions.fun_fact: The title is read as Christmas Evil, and Winter Falls served as its second lead single.

questions.question: Which NCT unit released the special winter EP Candy in December 2022?
questions.fun_fact: The title song remakes Candy, a 1996 hit by H.O.T., and all six tracks on the EP have a Christmas theme.

questions.question: Which SM singer released the Christmas EP This Christmas: Winter Is Coming in 2017?
questions.fun_fact: To promote it, she held three Christmas concerts called The Magic of Christmas Time from December 22 to 24, 2017.

questions.question: Which singer-songwriter released Winter Flower, featuring RM of BTS, in January 2020?
questions.fun_fact: RM helped write the lyrics, and because of their schedules the two made the song remotely, by phone and email.

questions.question: Who sang Merry Christmas Ahead, the 2010 holiday song featuring Thunder of MBLAQ?
questions.fun_fact: It first appeared as a B-side on her EP Real, and it has re-entered Korean charts in December year after year.

questions.question: Which group reunited in January 2025 with Winter Heptagon, an EP led by Python?
questions.fun_fact: The members wrote and composed every song, and the release, the first in three years, coincided with the group's 11th anniversary.

questions.question: Merry-Chri, a 2004 single that became a Christmas favorite in Japan, was released by which singer?
questions.fun_fact: She wrote the Korean lyrics herself, and the American rock band Weezer later recorded a cover of the song.

questions.question: Red Velvet teamed up with which girl group on Beautiful Christmas, lead single of 2022 Winter SM Town: SMCU Palace?
questions.fun_fact: The album was SM Town's tenth winter album, released on December 26, 2022, and 58 of the label's artists took part in it.

questions.question: Which BTS member sang Christmas Tree for the soundtrack of the 2021 drama Our Beloved Summer?
questions.fun_fact: The song was released on December 24, 2021, Christmas Eve, by Most Contents.
